reader.requirement: At --std 85 a Report Section printable item with VALUE and no GROUP INDICATE must show its literal every time its report group is printed; with GROUP INDICATE the literal is shown only on the first presentation of the detail group in the report, after every page advance and after every control break (or, with neither PAGE nor CONTROL, the first presentation after INITIATE), and spaces otherwise.

reader.notes: A GROUP INDICATE item is emitted under a presence guard on CobolReport.GroupIndicatePresent, armed by INITIATE, PageFeed and a control break and consumed after a presentation; an unindicated VALUE item is placed unconditionally on every presentation. 'Spaces supplied' is realised as the item placing nothing on a space-filled line, which prints identically. The 85 arm (occasion consumed only by a presentation) matches the 1985 wording 'first presentation'.

refuter.evidence: Attacked the 1985 'spaces supplied' wording (§1985:XIII.3.13.4 GR1) against the engine's 2023-style 'absent item' realisation: refute-1985-204/rv1.cob, a detail whose first LINE holds ONLY a GROUP INDICATE VALUE item, at --std 85 (runs/rv1-002) prints 'GI' on presentation 1 and a BLANK line (not a dropped line) before 'VV 2' and 'VV 3', so the line is still presented with spaces; RH VALUE ZERO/SPACES/"Q" printed '000', blanks, 'Q '; a VALUE "JR" JUSTIFIED RIGHT item printed left-aligned 'JR  ' as GR1c requires. VALUE with BLANK WHEN ZERO is refused COBOL2247 (§1985:XIII.3.9.3 SR11 Table 1), correctly. GI state is per detail group (ArmGroupIndicate sets every _details entry; GroupIndicatePresent read after the group's own page advance). cite.py: OK §1985:XIII.3.22.4 GR2 'will assume the specified value each time its report group is printed'; OK §1985:XIII.3.13.4 GR1 'SOURCE or VALUE clause to be ignored and spaces supplied'; OK §1985:XIII.3.22.4 GR1c 'Initialization is not affected by any BLANK WHEN ZERO or JUSTIFIED clause'.
